C-60.Name: Apply footnote setting changes to already open documents
C-60.Summary: Fix the reported footnote toggle bug: enabling or disabling Settings → Markdown → Footnotes immediately reparses open Markdown under the selected grammar, without reopening the file. Preserve text, unsaved state, selection, scroll and undo/redo; cached tabs and history must not restore the previous grammar.
C-60.Problem: Muya.setOptions only renders the existing block tree. Definitions parsed while footnotes were disabled remain paragraphs after enabling the option; disabling leaves footnote figures behind. Reopening reparses them correctly.

Goals.R-1: A real footnote option change with rendering requested reparses the current in-memory Markdown before rendering, in both directions.
Goals.R-2: The view change creates no content edit, autosave or undo step, preserves the current source selection and scroll, and retains unsaved edits and undo/redo.
Goals.R-3: Undo/redo lazily reparses snapshots whose footnote grammar differs. Tab activation cannot reuse blocks from the previous grammar.

Constraints.Item: Use the current in-memory text; never reload from disk to apply a preference.
Keep inline-only options and ordinary theme rerenders on their existing inexpensive render path.
Preserve existing uncommitted work, including C-57 changes in the routed graph and verification files.

NonGoals.Item: No release, installed-app replacement, preference migration or changes to callout syntax; no general parser-option redesign.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit regression fails before the fix and passes after it for off → on → off, unchanged Markdown, selection/scroll, no new history/change events, and undo/redo under the current setting.
Renderer tests cover cached-tab invalidation. Browser integration in Chromium and WebKit toggles footnotes without a reload, preserves unsaved state and exercises undo/redo and a tab switch.
Graph, verification, module contracts/maps and change summaries describe the final behavior. Selected C-60 target/final lint passes; global baseline errors are reported separately.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Old-code failure, targeted regression results, full renderer suite, browser assertions and scoped GRACE evidence.

Approval.ApprovalScope: Fix the diagnosed footnote preference bug and the directly affected selection, history and tab-cache behavior; routine implementation and verification choices are delegated by this request.

Completion.Summary: Implemented and verified; evidence in plan.xml. No release cut.
